text: 金砖国家财长和央行行长周五再次呼吁紧急改革国际货币基金组织(IMF)和世界银行，以提高新兴和发展中经济体在这两家机构中的话语权。他们在一份联合声明中表示，二战后建立的布雷顿森林机构应更好地反映全球经济格局的变化；呼吁提高新兴和发展中经济体在IMF的份额和投票权。他们还支持提升这些经济体在IMF和世界银行领导层中的代表性。财长和央行行长在声明中表示，“我们再次强调，迫切需要改革布雷顿森林机构，使其更加灵活、高效、可信、包容、切合使命、公正、负责，并更具代表性。”（彭博）
text_en: BRICS finance ministers and central bank governors on Friday once again called for urgent reform of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and the World Bank to increase the voice of emerging and developing economies in the two institutions. In a joint statement, they said the Bretton Woods institutions established after World War II should better reflect changes in the global economic landscape and called for increasing the quotas and voting rights of emerging and developing economies in the IMF. They also supported enhancing the representation of these economies in the leadership of the IMF and the World Bank. The finance ministers and central bank governors said in the statement, "We once again emphasize the urgent need to reform the Bretton Woods institutions to make them more flexible, efficient, credible, inclusive, fit for purpose, fair, accountable, and more representative." (Bloomberg)
